title: Procurement & Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Procurement & Supply Chain Analyst( Ahmedabad )**

**Role - overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytically strong Procurement Executive to support procurement and sourcing operations within an import-driven business environment. This role focuses on execution, RFQ management, supplier coordination, and cost analysis, working closely with the Procurement Manager.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working with importer-focused companies (India-based or foreign based ) and operating within international procurement environments, with strong capability in landed cost analysis and data-driven decision support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Procurement Manager in day-to-day procurement and sourcing activities.
* Assist in supplier identification, evaluation, and onboarding across South Asia and global markets.
* Execute and support the RFQ (Request for Quotation) process, including:
* Preparing RFQs based on product specifications and business requirements
* Sending RFQs to suppliers and ensuring timely responses and follow-ups
* Compiling supplier quotations and preparing comparison sheets
* Supporting detailed cost breakdown analysis and data validation
* Prepare and maintain landed cost structures, including product cost, freight, duties, tariffs, and other associated cost components.
* Conduct cost analysis and pricing evaluation to support procurement decision-making and margin planning.
* Support the development of pricing inputs and cost models for bid proposals (final pricing ownership remains with the Manager).
* Maintain procurement data within ERP systems and internal tools.
* Track purchase orders and ensure timely follow-ups with suppliers.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of product specifications, RFQ documentation, and procurement data.
* Generate reports and insights to support cost optimization and operational efficiency.

**Key Qualifications**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred, preferably in Supply Chain, Operations, International Business, or related field.

**Experience**

* 5–7 years of experience in procurement or sourcing functions.
* Mandatory experience supporting importer-focused companies (India-based or global) operating in import-driven business models.
* Proven experience working within an international procurement environment.
* Experience supporting foreign-based importer companies is preferred.
* Hands-on experience working with suppliers across South Asia and other global sourcing regions.
* Practical experience in RFQ preparation, issuance, and quotation analysis.

**Import Environment & Cost Understanding**

* Proven experience working in environments involving international trade and import cost structures, including:
* Customs duties and tariffs
* Freight and logistics cost components
* Incoterms and related cost implications
* Strong ability to understand and incorporate landed cost components into cost analysis and pricing support (coordination with logistics providers is not a primary responsibility).

**Systems, Analytics & Costing**

* Experience with ERP systems and procurement tools.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and modeling.
* Proven ability to prepare and analyze landed cost structures with accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical mindset with focus on data accuracy and structured evaluation.

**Role Scope**

* Primary focus on execution, analysis, RFQ support, and supplier onboarding.
* Supports pricing and cost analysis, but does not own supplier negotiations or final commercial decisions.
* Works closely with the Procurement Manager to enable data-driven procurement outcomes.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Strong analytical and detail-oriented mindset.
* High level of ownership and execution focus.
* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, global sourcing environment.

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Shift Timing:** Night Shift Only (WFO)

**Locations:** Ahmedabad  
**Work Mode:** On-site

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Experience:

* Procurement management: 5 years (Required)

Location:

* Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Required)

Shift availability:

* Night Shift (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Analyst - Supply Chain Management-2
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Title** : Analyst, European Order Management / Back-Office Customer Service
  
**Proposed Band** : B14-B17
  
**Location** : GCC India
  
**Reports to:** Team Lead, European Order Management / Back-Office Customer Service
  
  
Role Purpose
  
The Analyst is responsible for executing day-to-day activities within European Order Management / Back-Office Customer Service from GCC India, ensuring accurate, timely, and customer-focused execution across the assigned scope. The role is expected to protect the customer experience by taking ownership of order flow, proactively identifying service risks, resolving issues with urgency, and keeping stakeholders informed with clarity and professionalism.
  
  
The role supports the delivery of core back-office customer service processes and plays an important part in maintaining service continuity, quality, responsiveness, and customer confidence. Depending on experience and capability, the role may operate with different levels of autonomy, complexity handling, and ownership across the assigned scope. The Analyst is expected to balance the needs of external customers with the requirements of internal stakeholders and business partners, always applying a customer-first mindset while following defined processes, controls, and service expectations.
  
  
Core Accountability

* Execute day-to-day order management / back-office customer service activities for the assigned country or customer scope with a clear focus on delivering a reliable and responsive customer experience
* Process and manage customer orders and related transactions accurately, on time, and in line with defined service expectations, controls, and ways of working
* Support order confirmation, order updates, delivery coordination, issue resolution, and related transaction processing across the order lifecycle to minimise customer disruption
* Monitor assigned order or customer portfolios daily, proactively identifying issues, delays, inconsistencies, or service risks that may impact customer experience and taking appropriate action
* Resolve operational issues within own scope, including exceptions related to orders, deliveries, damaged goods, delayed shipments, blocks, or documentation gaps, with urgency and ownership
* Escalate issues, risks, delays, and unresolved exceptions in a timely and structured way through defined governance, ensuring customer impact and urgency are clearly communicated
* Prepare, maintain, and validate relevant documentation required for transaction processing, delivery support, customer communication, and record completeness
* Communicate with customers, internal stakeholders, logistics partners, warehouses, and other relevant parties in a clear, professional, and solution-oriented manner to support smooth service delivery and issue resolution
* Build effective working relationships with Customer Service, Supply Chain, Trade to Cash, DMO, and other relevant stakeholders to support service reliability, customer trust, and positive customer outcomes
* Maintain strong process discipline, compliance, and control awareness while ensuring processes are executed in a way that supports customer service commitments
* Use reporting and service data to manage priorities, track workload, anticipate customer-impacting risks, and highlight issues to the Team Lead
* Identify opportunities to improve process consistency, service quality, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction, and raise ideas through the appropriate channels
* Support transitions, process updates, new tools, and continuous improvement initiatives where they improve service stability, customer visibility, or speed of resolution
  

Scope / Complexity Markers

* Operates within a critical order management / back-office customer service environment supporting European markets from GCC India, where service reliability directly influences the customer experience
* Delivers transactional and service execution across an assigned customer, market, or country-aligned scope with accountability for accuracy, responsiveness, and follow-through
* Works in a multi-stakeholder environment requiring coordination across internal functions, service partners, and operational teams to resolve issues and protect customer commitments
* Handles a mix of routine processing, issue resolution, exception management, and stakeholder communication, often requiring judgement on customer impact and urgency
* Requires judgement in prioritisation, issue escalation, and balancing service quality with pace, accuracy, and customer need
* At more experienced levels, may handle more complex portfolios, higher-risk exceptions, broader stakeholder interaction, and greater independence in resolving customer-impacting issues
  

Role Expectations

* Deliver high-quality, timely, and customer-focused execution across assigned order management and back-office customer service activities
* Demonstrate a strong service mindset, recognising external customers as the ultimate priority while effectively managing internal stakeholder needs
* Apply process discipline and follow defined controls, standards, and ways of working consistently, while keeping customer commitments and service outcomes in focus
* Escalate issues with clarity, ownership, and customer impact context, while contributing to timely resolution
* Work collaboratively with team members and stakeholders to support service continuity, customer satisfaction, and confidence in issue handling
* Stay adaptable through process changes, transitions, and continuous improvement efforts, maintaining a positive and solution-focused approach to customer service
* At more experienced levels, contribute as a go-to support within the team for process knowledge, issue handling, customer-impacting escalations, and onboarding support where needed
  

Experience / Capability Requirements

* Experience in order management, customer service, shared services, supply chain operations, or a related business services environment with direct exposure to customer-impacting processes
* Proven ability to work in a transactional or operational environment with strong attention to accuracy, timeliness, and service quality
* Strong customer service orientation, with the ability to understand customer needs, communicate clearly, and balance external customer experience with internal stakeholder expectations
* Ability to manage day-to-day operational issues, exceptions, and competing priorities in a structured manner, considering urgency, business impact, and customer consequences
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across functions, geographies, and stakeholder groups to drive resolution and maintain customer confidence
* Process discipline and control awareness in executing operational activities without losing sight of service outcomes
* Analytical and problem-solving capability, with comfort using data and reporting to support execution priorities, identify service risks, and improve customer responsiveness
* Experience working with ERP-enabled transactional processes and service-related reporting
* For broader banding within the role, progression is expected through increasing complexity, independence, judgement, ownership of customer-impacting issues, and contribution to team capability rather than through formal people leadership
  

**B14-B17 Banding Rationale**

* Individual contributor role with accountability for accurate, timely, and customer-focused service execution across a defined scope
* Applicable across a range of analyst profiles, with scope increasing based on experience, process knowledge, autonomy, customer-impact awareness, and complexity handled
* More junior profiles are expected to operate with closer guidance on standard transactional activities, while more experienced profiles may independently manage more complex portfolios, exceptions, customer-impacting risks, and stakeholder interactions
* The role does not carry formal people leadership accountability, but more experienced analysts may informally support onboarding, knowledge sharing, execution consistency, and stronger customer-focused ways of working within the team

title: Research Analyst
description:
**Job description:**

InvestMentor Securities Ltd. is a fast-growing and leading full-service stock broker in Gujarat. Supported by experienced research analysts, the company offers in-depth market analysis and research reports. Known for its advanced technology-driven approach, clients can trade conveniently using the user-friendly mobile app from anywhere. With a strong commitment to customer satisfaction, the company has established itself as a trusted name in the stock-broking industry, building a loyal client base.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented Equity Research Analyst with strong market understanding and analytical capabilities. The candidate will conduct in-depth analysis of stocks, sectors, derivatives and market trends, and provide actionable insights to drive investment decisions. The role also involves preparing research reports, creating content for investors, and engaging in client-facing communication.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct thorough research on stocks, sectors, F&O, and market trends.
* Analyses financial statements, balance sheets, sector data, market information, and economic indicators.
* Develop financial models and perform valuation analysis using industry-standard methods.
* Create and publish research reports, market insights, and investment recommendations.
* Prepare presentations, daily/weekly outlook reports, and investment cases.
* Stay updated with industry developments, global markets, and new research methodologies.
* Collaborate with the in-house research and advisory team on strategy building.
* Be comfortable in **making educational videos, daily market insights, and hosting webinars** for clients.
* Work with **algo strategy builders & third-party algo vendors**, and provide inputs for strategy development & back-testing.
* Track derivatives data (OI, PCR, rollovers, IV) and use it in market interpretation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, MBA, or a related field.
* Proven work experience in equity research, brokerage, wealth management, or investment banking.
* **Strong knowledge of F&O markets, derivatives, technical and fundamental analysis.**
* Experience working with **algo strategy builders / third-party algo vendors** (e.g., Tradetron, Algotest, Quantower, etc.)
* Ability to analyse and interpret charts, OI data, volume, and price action.
* Excellent analytical and communication skills — **must be comfortable speaking on camera and conducting webinars.**

· **Note**: NISM-Series-VIII: Equity Derivatives & NISM-Series-XV; Research Analyst Certification is MANDOTARY

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Experience:**

* Equity research: 1 year (Required)

**Location:**

* Ashram Road P.O, Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Required)

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you currently based in Ahmedabad
* Do you have at least 1 year of professional experience in equity research, with strong knowledge of F&O, derivatives, technical analysis, and fundamental analysis?
* Do you hold both NISM-Series-VIII (Equity Derivatives) and NISM-Series-XV (Research Analyst) certifications?

title: Manager, Marketing Intelligence & Analytics
description:
**Req #** 211005 **Location** Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India **Job Category** Marketing **Date posted** 10/23/2026

  

**Overview**
------------

This is where creativity meets strategy. As a member of the Baxter Marketing team, you will work on designing, developing and implementing marketing programs and pricing strategies. You’ll leverage your expertise to present our life-sustaining and live-saving products and services to the relevant market sector. Working in collaboration with the sales and technical teams, there will be opportunity for learning, development and future career growth across a variety of fields within Baxter.

* Support for Parents
* Continuing Education/ Professional Development
* Employee Health & Well-Being Benefits
* Paid Time Off
* 2 Days a Year to Volunteer

**Success Profile**
-------------------

What makes a successful Marketing team member at Baxter? Take a look at some of the top traits we’re looking for and see if you’re a fit.

* Compelling & Concise Communication
* Creative & Innovative Thinking
* Strategic Planning
* Competitive Intelligence
* Collaborative
* Digitally Savvy

  

**This is where** your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

As the Manager, Market & Competitive Intelligence (MICI) for the Global Infusion Therapies & Platform (ITP) business, you will serve as the strategic engine behind market understanding, competitive intelligence, and growth opportunity identification across the ITP portfolio. You will lead the development of global market models, competitive intelligence frameworks, and insight platforms that support marketing, portfolio strategy, business development, innovation investments, and executive decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with Global Marketing, Commercial Operations, Medical Affairs, R&D, Strategy, Market Access, and Finance teams to generate actionable insights that influence Baxter's pharmaceutical portfolio and long-term growth strategy.

**What you will be doing:**

Market Models:

* Develop and maintain global market size, share, growth, forecast models across the ITP portfolio including infusion-based pharmaceutical therapies, clinical nutrition, injectable products, specialty therapeutics, and related digital health solutions.
* Build top-down and bottom-up forecasts using IQVIA data, epidemiology, prescription trends, treatment pathways, customer insights, and macroeconomic indicators.
* Conduct scenario analysis to evaluate the impact of regulatory, competitive, pricing, reimbursement, and healthcare policy changes.
* Own long-range market outlooks support strategic planning, portfolio prioritization, lifecycle management, and business development.
Translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations for leadership teams.  

Market & Competitive Intelligence:

* Build and maintain a comprehensive intelligence repository covering competitors, emerging biotech companies, pipeline products, clinical developments, licensing activities, Merger & Acquisition activity, and market dynamics.
* Monitor therapeutic, clinical, regulatory, and scientific trends impacting the portfolio.
* Deliver proactive competitive assessments highlighting opportunities, risks, business implications, and strategic recommendations.
* Develop regular intelligence reports, dashboards, executive briefings, and deep-dive analyses.
* Standardize and automate intelligence reporting and knowledge-management processes.
  

  

Strategic Analytics:

* Partner with marketing and strategy teams to develop Total Addressable Market /Served Addressable Market assessments, market attractiveness evaluations, and growth opportunity analyses.

* Support business cases for new product development, lifecycle management, acquisitions, partnerships, and licensing opportunities.
* Conduct market segmentation, patient journey, and therapy adoption analyses.
* Provide insights supporting portfolio optimization and strategic investment decisions.
  

  

Digital Transformation & Reporting

* Lead digitization and automation of market intelligence processes and reporting frameworks.
* Develop scalable dashboards and self-service analytics solutions using Power BI, Tableau, SharePoint, and other visualization platforms.
* Improve accessibility, standardization, governance, and knowledge sharing of market insights across stakeholders.
  

  

GEOX Support & Drive Special Projects:

* Evaluate country and regional expansion opportunities through market sizing, epidemiology, patient journey, and white-space analyses.
* Develop business cases assessing revenue potential, profitability, ROI, portfolio prioritization, and resource allocation.
* Evaluate pricing benchmarks, market access, and reimbursement dynamics across markets.
* Develop dashboards to monitor launch performance and Geographic Expansion Vitality Tracking.
* Partners with Global, Regional, and Local teams across Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Finance, and Supply Chain functions to align assumptions, launch plans, and strategic recommendations.

**What you will be bringing:**

* Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Marketing, Business, Healthcare Management, or related fields.
* MBA, master’s degree, or advanced pharmaceutical/business education preferred.

* 8 to 12 years of professional experience in Market Intelligence, Competitive Intelligence, Strategic Analytics, Commercial Excellence, or Portfolio Strategy.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in the Pharmaceutical, Biopharmaceutical, Specialty Pharma, Healthcare, or MedTech industry.
* Strong exposure to global pharmaceutical markets and commercial strategy.

* Expertise in pharmaceutical market modelling, forecasting, and strategic analytics.
* Strong understanding of drug development, commercialization, regulatory pathways, and market access dynamics.
* Experience using pharmaceutical datasets such as IQVIA, Evaluate Pharma, Clarivate, Cite line, GlobalData, Definitive Healthcare, and related industry sources.
* Advanced skills in Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Think-cell, and data visualization tools.
* Excellent stakeholder management, storytelling, and executive presentation capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional and senior leadership teams in global organizations.
  

  

Preferred Experience:

* Infusion therapies, injectable products, clinical nutrition, hospital pharmaceuticals, specialty therapeutics, or adjacent healthcare sectors.
* Experience supporting portfolio strategy, business development, licensing evaluations, and commercial launch planning.
* Exposure to global, regional, and emerging pharmaceutical markets.
* Emerging Market Expertise

title: Analyst I - Global Project Management

The **Analyst I, Global Project Management Operations** supports the planning, execution, governance, and reporting of strategic projects across global operations. This role is responsible for coordinating project activities, maintaining project documentation, tracking milestones, managing project data, and supporting governance processes to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.

The role partners closely with project managers, functional teams, business stakeholders, and global operations leaders to drive project excellence, continuous improvement, and operational efficiency.

* Coordinate project meetings, workshops, and governance reviews.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and action items.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of project activities.
* Maintain project schedules and update progress against defined plans.

### **PMO Governance & Reporting**

### **Process Improvement**

title: Pre-Sales Business Analyst
description:
Full Time Ahmedabad 4 years

  

The Pre-Sales Business Analyst owns the process of turning client inquiries and business requirements into clearly defined scopes, realistic estimates, and client-ready proposals. This is an analytical, commercially aware, and documentation-driven solutioning role — not a purely administrative quoting position, a technical delivery role, or a sales role focused solely on closing deals.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Account Managers, Project Managers, Technical Leads, and the Quoting Department to understand what clients need, identify what it will take to deliver it, and ensure proposals accurately reflect the agreed scope, assumptions, timelines, dependencies, and commercial expectations.

Your role is to bring structure and clarity to opportunities before they become projects. You’ll ask the right questions, challenge incomplete requirements, coordinate estimation, identify scope risks, and ensure that both the client-facing team and delivery team understand what is being proposed before commitments are made.

***This role is probably not for you if:***

* You prefer preparing quotations from information provided by others without investigating gaps or validating requirements
* You treat proposal writing as a documentation exercise rather than a process of defining what the client actually needs
* You routinely pass unclear requirements to technical teams instead of asking questions and establishing clarity
* You prioritize closing opportunities over ensuring that the proposed scope is realistic and deliverable
* You are uncomfortable challenging assumptions, identifying risks, or distinguishing confirmed requirements from unanswered questions
* You prefer working on one task at a time and find it difficult to manage multiple quotes, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously

***This role is for someone who enjoys:***

* Turning complex or incomplete client requirements into clear, structured, and actionable scopes of work
* Asking thoughtful questions before estimation begins rather than discovering gaps after a project has started
* Connecting business objectives with technical feasibility, delivery effort, timelines, and commercial expectations
* Taking ownership of the proposal process from initial inquiry through final submission and follow-up
* Working across Sales, Account Management, and Delivery to ensure everyone understands what is being promised

If you’re analytical, commercially aware, and naturally inclined to bring clarity to ambiguity, this role gives you meaningful ownership over the quality of opportunities before they enter delivery.

### **What you’ll really be doing**

#### **1. Discovery and Requirement Gathering**

* Participate in pre-sales discovery and scoping calls alongside Account Managers and Sales teams
* Understand the client’s business objectives, underlying problems, functional requirements, technical expectations, and desired outcomes
* Ask targeted questions to clarify requirements, constraints, priorities, and success criteria before estimation begins
* Identify missing information, conflicting expectations, assumptions, and potential scope gaps
* Distinguish confirmed requirements from hypotheses and open questions, ensuring unresolved items are addressed before commitments are made

#### **2. Scope Definition and SOW Writing**

* Translate client requirements into structured, accurate, and client-friendly Scope of Work (SOW) documents, proposals, and requirement summaries
* Define project deliverables, functional requirements, exclusions, assumptions, dependencies, and responsibilities
* Establish clear boundaries between in-scope and out-of-scope work
* Document timelines, milestones, constraints, and dependencies wherever applicable
* Ensure proposals communicate what will be delivered, what is excluded, and what conditions must be met for successful execution
* Maintain consistency between discovery notes, estimates, proposals, and the final agreed scope

#### **3. Quote Preparation and Estimation Coordination**

* Own the end-to-end quote preparation process, from initial inquiry and requirement clarification through estimation, proposal preparation, and final submission
* Coordinate with Technical Leads, Project Managers, and the Quoting Department to validate effort estimates and technical feasibility
* Ensure the proposed solution aligns with delivery capabilities, resource availability, project complexity, and expected timelines
* Identify estimation gaps, dependencies, and risks that could affect delivery effort or commercial viability
* Consolidate inputs from multiple stakeholders into a coherent, accurate, and client-ready proposal
* Ensure estimates and scope documents are complete before proposals are shared with clients

#### **4. Sales Coordination and Commercial Alignment**

* Partner with Sales and Account Managers to support qualified opportunities through the proposal and negotiation stages
* Ensure proposed solutions address client needs while remaining commercially appropriate and operationally feasible
* Support proposal walkthroughs, scope clarification, pricing discussions, and revisions when requirements change
* Identify situations where client expectations, proposed budgets, and delivery realities are misaligned
* Help stakeholders understand the commercial and delivery implications of scope changes
* Recommend clarification or revision when a proposal contains unrealistic commitments, unresolved assumptions, or material delivery risks

#### **5. Quote Follow-Up and Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate records of active quotes, proposal statuses, revisions, approvals, and next actions
* Coordinate with Sales and Account Managers to follow up on pending proposals, client feedback, and internal approvals
* Track opportunities that are delayed, inactive, awaiting clarification, or approaching decision deadlines
* Ensure every qualified opportunity has a documented status, responsible stakeholder, and appropriate next step
* Identify process gaps that cause delays, missed follow-ups, or opportunities being overlooked
* Maintain visibility into the proposal pipeline to support prioritization and forecasting

#### **6. Reporting, Analysis, and Process Improvement**

* Prepare monthly reports covering quote volume, conversion rates, win/loss trends, deal sizes, and proposal status
* Analyze recurring reasons for lost opportunities, delayed decisions, and unsuccessful proposals
* Identify patterns in estimation discrepancies, scope gaps, and proposal revisions
* Provide leadership with insights that support forecasting, resource planning, and commercial decision-making
* Recommend improvements to discovery questionnaires, estimation workflows, proposal templates, and tracking processes
* Use available data to identify opportunities to improve proposal quality, turnaround time, and conversion performance

#### **7. Cross-Functional Coordination and Delivery Handoff**

* Collaborate with Project Managers, Technical Leads, and Delivery Teams to validate proposed scope, complexity, assumptions, and dependencies
* Identify delivery risks and unresolved requirements before project approval
* Ensure the final approved scope and supporting documentation accurately reflect the commitments made during pre-sales
* Facilitate a structured handoff to the delivery team, including requirements, estimates, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and relevant client context
* Clarify discrepancies between the approved proposal and the delivery team’s understanding before execution begins
* Retain accountability for the completeness and accuracy of pre-sales documentation through the handoff process

### **Who will thrive in this role**

* **Analytical by nature** — you break down complex requirements, identify patterns, and understand the implications before recommending a solution
* **Clear with complexity** — you can turn technical and business requirements into structured, understandable documentation without losing important details
* **Curious and thorough** — you ask meaningful questions, investigate missing information, and validate assumptions instead of accepting incomplete inputs
* **Commercially aware** — you understand the relationship between scope, effort, pricing, timelines, client expectations, and delivery feasibility
* **Comfortable with ambiguity** — you can identify what is known, document what is missing, and coordinate the right people to reach a decision
* **Accountable for accuracy** — you take ownership of proposal completeness, estimation coordination, follow-ups, and documentation quality
* **Collaborative across functions** — you can work effectively with Sales, Account Management, Technical Leads, Project Managers, and delivery teams
* **Organized under pressure** — you can manage multiple opportunities, changing requirements, proposal revisions, and deadlines without losing attention to detail
* **Confident in client-facing discussions** — you can ask clarifying questions, explain scope decisions, and communicate professionally with clients and internal stakeholders

### **How Success Will Be Visible**

* **Requirement clarity** — Proposals are based on sufficiently understood business needs, with unresolved questions and assumptions clearly documented
* **Scope accuracy** — Deliverables, exclusions, dependencies, and responsibilities are clearly defined before client approval
* **Estimation reliability** — Estimates are validated with the appropriate technical and delivery stakeholders and reflect realistic effort and complexity
* **Proposal quality** — Client-ready proposals are complete, consistent, commercially aligned, and easy to understand
* **Process ownership** — Quotes move through discovery, estimation, preparation, submission, and follow-up with clear ownership and next actions
* **Pipeline visibility** — Active opportunities, proposal stages, pending approvals, and follow-ups are accurately tracked
* **Commercial performance** — Quote conversion, turnaround time, and win/loss trends are monitored and used to identify improvement opportunities
* **Delivery readiness** — Approved projects are handed over with clear scope, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and supporting documentation
* **Reduced scope gaps** — Fewer avoidable misunderstandings, missing requirements, and preventable scope-related issues emerge after project initiation

### **Qualifications & Skills**

#### **Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Business Analysis, Solution Scoping, Proposal Management, or a closely related role
* Proven experience preparing client-facing proposals, Scopes of Work (SOWs), requirement documents, and estimation-related documentation
* Experience coordinating with technical and business stakeholders to validate requirements, effort estimates, and delivery feasibility
* Experience managing multiple proposals and opportunities across different stages of the pre-sales process

#### **Must Have Skills**

* Strong business analysis and requirement-gathering skills, with the ability to translate business needs into structured scopes and deliverables
* Demonstrated experience creating clear, comprehensive, and client-friendly SOWs, proposals, and requirement summaries
* Strong understanding of scope definition, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, timelines, and estimation fundamentals
* Commercial awareness and the ability to balance client expectations, sales objectives, and delivery feasibility
* Experience participating in client discovery calls and facilitating requirement clarification discussions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex requirements in straightforward language
* Effective stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple quotes, revisions, and deadlines simultaneously
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks, inconsistencies, and missing information before proposal submission
* Familiarity with digital agency, web development, e-commerce, or technology services project lifecycles

#### **Tools & Platforms**

* CRM and pipeline management tools such as HubSpot, Pipedrive, or similar platforms
* Project management and collaboration tools such as ClickUp, Jira, or equivalent systems
* Documentation and proposal preparation tools, including Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, or similar platforms
* Estimation templates, quote trackers, and reporting tools used to manage the pre-sales process

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a digital agency, web development company, technology consultancy, or white-label service delivery environment
* Familiarity with WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce, Laravel, Vue.js, or custom web development projects
* Exposure to project estimation, sprint planning, resource planning, or delivery coordination
* Experience working with US-based clients or collaborating across international teams and time zones
* Experience analyzing quote conversion rates, win/loss trends, deal sizes, and proposal turnaround times
* Ability to identify scope risks, challenge assumptions, and proactively recommend improvements to the solutioning process
* Experience improving proposal templates, discovery workflows, estimation processes, or pre-sales documentation standards

### **What this role offers**

* End-to-end ownership of the quote preparation and proposal development process
* Direct collaboration with Sales, Account Management, Technical Leads, Project Managers, and Delivery Teams
* Meaningful influence over solution quality, scope accuracy, estimation reliability, and commercial alignment
* The opportunity to strengthen the connection between client expectations and delivery capabilities
* A role that values analytical thinking, structured documentation, sound judgment, and proactive problem-solving

**The Standard:** Every proposal should reflect a clear understanding of the client’s needs, a realistic view of delivery capabilities, and a well-defined set of commitments. The goal is not simply to produce a quote — it is to ensure that the right work is proposed, understood, and ready to be delivered.
